rules.prepare:
# The "config" script would guess the platform from the machine we build on. case "$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" in aarch64*) OPENSSL_TARGET="linux-aarch64" ;; loongarch64*) OPENSSL_TARGET="linux64-loongarch64" ;; powerpc64le*) OPENSSL_TARGET="linux-ppc64le" ;; riscv64*) OPENSSL_TARGET="linux64-riscv64" ;; s390x*) OPENSSL_TARGET="linux64-s390x" ;; x86_64*) OPENSSL_TARGET="linux-x86_64" ;; *) echo "No OpenSSL target known for $AELTRA_HOST_TYPE." >&2 exit 1 ;; esac
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/Configure" "$OPENSSL_TARGET" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --cross-compile-prefix="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-" \ --openssldir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/ssl" \ --libdir=lib \ \ no-idea no-mdc2 no-rc5 no-zlib no-ssl3 no-ssl3-method \ no-async no-capieng no-rdrand enable-rfc3779 enable-cms enable-tfo
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install_sw install_ssldirs
mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/ssl"
for item in certs openssl.cnf private; do mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/ssl/$item" "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/ssl/" ln -s "/etc/ssl/$item" "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/ssl/" done
chmod 0700 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/ssl/private"
